name: Donut Dongle gameID v0.7.26
body:
**RetroTink Experimental Firmware**
- Rollback to previous firmware versions now supported.
- Release notes on mobile are now properly positioned, UI tweaks.

**Mobile UX**
- Double-tapping on the Menu icon jumps between top and bottom of that section. This allows you to quickly...
  - Switch between both types of Remotes.
  - Move to top and bottom of the File list, gameID / Settings, and Dashboard tabs.
